filing-er27-506-caiso-large-loads.point: CAISO says its revisions, with the transmission owners', answer the show cause order.
filing-er27-506-caiso-large-loads.quote: Taken together, the CAISO and Participating Transmission Owner (PTO) tariff revisions supply the tariff-level clarity, customer protections, and operational tools the Order seeks.

filing-er27-506-caiso-large-loads.point: A large load is a single site of 50 MW or more.
filing-er27-506-caiso-large-loads.quote: and that has a peak load of 50 MW or greater.

filing-er27-506-caiso-large-loads.point: Deposits, security and cost recovery are left to each transmission owner's tariff.
filing-er27-506-caiso-large-loads.quote: the PTOs will implement just and reasonable deposit, security, reimbursement, and cost-recovery provisions in their own tariffs

filing-er27-506-caiso-large-loads.point: Generator interconnection customers must disclose plans to serve co-located load.
filing-er27-506-caiso-large-loads.quote: requires generator interconnection customers to disclose plans to serve co- located load

filing-er27-506-caiso-large-loads.point: FILI would let flexible loads energize before network upgrades are finished.
filing-er27-506-caiso-large-loads.quote: The CAISO’s Flexible Interim Load Interconnection (FILI) can permit earlier energization while network upgrades are pending

filing-er27-506-caiso-large-loads.point: A permanent flexible service is left for later work.
filing-er27-506-caiso-large-loads.quote: with additional work planned on permanent flexibility and other emerging configurations

filing-er27-506-caiso-large-loads.point: Loads already operating or with a complete request before February 16, 2027 are not treated as large loads.
filing-er27-506-caiso-large-loads.quote: the CAISO will not consider any load a large load subject to the CAISO tariff where the load is operational or has a complete request with the PTO before the CAISO tariff revisions’ effective date of February 16, 2027

filing-er27-506-caiso-large-loads.point: CAISO asks for a February 16, 2027 effective date and a 30-day comment period.
filing-er27-506-caiso-large-loads.quote: the CAISO requests that the Commission accept the tariff revisions contained in this filing effective February 16, 2027

filing-er27-506-caiso-large-loads.point: Scheduling and settlement software changes come later, in November 2027 and April 2028.
filing-er27-506-caiso-large-loads.quote: effective November 1, 2027, and the tariff revisions in Section 11.36 (settlements) effective April 30, 2028
